currency_price_historical.name: OBB.CURRENCY.PRICE.HISTORICAL
currency_price_historical.description:
Currency Historical Price. Currency historical data.

Currency historical prices refer to the past exchange rates of one currency against
another over a specific period.
This data provides insight into the fluctuations and trends in the foreign exchange market,
helping analysts, traders, and economists understand currency performance,
evaluate economic health, and make predictions about future movements.

params.label: Symbol
params.description: Symbol to get data for. Can use CURR1-CURR2 or CURR1CURR2 format. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Start Date
params.description: Start date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: End Date
params.description: End date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: Interval
params.description: Time interval of the data to return. Options: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d.

currency_snapshots.name: OBB.CURRENCY.SNAPSHOTS
currency_snapshots.description: Snapshots of currency exchange rates from an indirect or direct perspective of a base currency.

params.label: Base
params.description: The base currency symbol. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Quote Type
params.description: Whether the quote is direct or indirect. Selecting 'direct' will return the exchange rate as the amount of domestic currency required to buy one unit of the foreign currency. Selecting 'indirect' (default) will return the exchange rate as the amount of foreign currency required to buy one unit of the domestic currency.

params.label: Counter Currencies
params.description: An optional list of counter currency symbols to filter for. None returns all.

derivatives_options_chains.name: OBB.DERIVATIVES.OPTIONS.CHAINS
derivatives_options_chains.description: Get the complete options chain for a ticker.

params.label: Symbol
params.description: Symbol to get data for.

params.label: Date
params.description: The end-of-day date for options chains data.

params.label: Option Type
params.description: The option type, call or put, 'None' is both (default). Options: call, put.

params.label: Moneyness
params.description: Return only contracts that are in or out of the money, default is 'all'. Parameter is ignored when a date is supplied. Options: otm, itm, all.

economy_country_profile.name: OBB.ECONOMY.COUNTRY_PROFILE
economy_country_profile.description: Get a profile of country statistics and economic indicators.

params.label: Country
params.description: The country to get data. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Latest
params.description: If True, return only the latest data. If False, return all available data for each indicator.

params.label: Use Cache
params.description: If True, the request will be cached for one day.Using cache is recommended to avoid needlessly requesting the same data.

economy_indicators.name: OBB.ECONOMY.INDICATORS
economy_indicators.description: Get economic indicators by country and indicator.

params.label: Symbol
params.description: Symbol to get data for. The base symbol for the indicator (e.g. GDP, CPI, etc.). Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Country
params.description: The country to get data. The country represented by the indicator, if available. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Start Date
params.description: Start date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: End Date
params.description: End date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: Transform
params.description: tusd` should only be used where values are currencies. Options: toya, tpop, tusd, tpgp.

params.label: Frequency
params.description: The frequency of the data, default is 'quarter'. Only valid when 'symbol' is 'main'. Options: annual, quarter, month.

params.label: Use Cache
params.description: If True, the request will be cached for one day. Using cache is recommended to avoid needlessly requesting the same data.

equity_estimates_price_target.description: Get analyst price targets by company.

params.description: Symbol to get data for. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Limit
params.description: The number of data entries to return.

params.label: Provider
params.description: Options: benzinga, fmp, defaults to benzinga.

params.label: Page
params.description: Page offset. For optimization, performance and technical reasons, page offsets are limited from 0 - 100000. Limit the query results by other parameters such as date. Used in conjunction with the limit and date parameters.

params.label: Date
params.description: Date for calendar data, shorthand for date_from and date_to.

params.label: Start Date
params.description: Start date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: End Date
params.description: End date of the data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.label: Updated
params.description: Records last Updated Unix timestamp (UTC). This will force the sort order to be Greater Than or Equal to the timestamp indicated. The date can be a date string or a Unix timestamp. The date string must be in the format of YYYY-MM-DD.

params.label: Importance
params.description: Importance level to filter by. Uses Greater Than or Equal To the importance indicated

params.label: Action
params.description: Filter by a specific action_company. Options: downgrades, maintains, reinstates, reiterates, upgrades, assumes, initiates, terminates, removes, suspends, firm_dissolved.

params.label: Analyst Ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of analyst (person) IDs. Omitting will bring back all available analysts. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Firm Ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of firm IDs. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: Fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. See https://docs.benzinga.io/benzinga-apis/calendar/get-ratings to learn about the available fields. Multiple comma separated items allowed.

params.label: With Grade
params.description: Include upgrades and downgrades in the response.
